text: A documentary crew travels to the Isan region of Thailand to film Nim, a medium possessed by the local deity Ba Yan, a role her sister Noi once refused. At the funeral of Noi's husband, Nim speaks of [the misfortune that has befallen the men of his family|wrong|sins of the ancestors], and soon [Noi's daughter Mink|who_suffers|families and parents] begins to hear voices and [shift between strange personalities|threat|being taken over]. Nim wonders whether Ba Yan has chosen Mink as the next host, until [the deity's statue is found decapitated|images|holy and occult objects].
